text: the dry run drives every step of the cell against the fixture target for both platforms, fails when a step is removed from the cell (one mutant per step, restored from a backup copy), and the receipt verifier refuses a receipt with a missing step row
why: Task 3.1's product is test code (tests/live/switch-autocheck.sh, its adapter and dry run), so prove-claim refuses every break under tests/. Proven by hand instead (2026-11-11): in a detached worktree with the staged work, removing the hardened step's sa_no_checkout call turned t_each_seeded_defect_is_caught RED ('checkout-appears ... expected [caught-by:sa_hardened] got [not-caught]'); the real tree was never edited. The dry run's own t_a_cell_with_any_step_removed_does_not_verify empties each of the six steps in a copy and asserts the run stops at or after that step; 20 seeded defects each fail their step.
